pattern: union two differently-headered tables, pivot, compute a difference, rank
question: rank centres by how much their turnout percentage dropped between the two years, worst first
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1
sql_duckdb: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, "Month" AS month, "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolled, "Avg Daily Present" AS present FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT "centre_name" AS centre, "month" AS month, "enrolment" AS enrolled, "average_attendance" AS present FROM attendance_2024), matched AS (SELECT c1.centre AS centre_2023, c2.centre AS centre_2024, c1.month AS month_2023, c2.month AS month_2024, c1.enrolled AS enrolled_2023, c2.enrolled AS enrolled_2024, c1.present AS present_2023, c2.present AS present_2024 FROM combined AS c1 JOIN combined AS c2 ON JARO_WINKLER_SIMILARITY(LOWER(TRIM(c1.centre)), LOWER(TRIM(c2.centre))) >= 0.9 AND c1.month = c2.month AND c1.centre <> c2.centre), turnout AS (SELECT centre_2023 AS centre, month_2023 AS month, present_2023 / NULLIF(NULLIF(enrolled_2023, 0), 0) AS turnout_2023, present_2024 / NULLIF(NULLIF(enrolled_2024, 0), 0) AS turnout_2024 FROM matched), diff AS (SELECT centre, month, (turnout_2024 - turnout_2023) AS diff FROM turnout) SELECT centre, month, diff FROM diff ORDER BY diff DESC

attempts.prompt:
You translate ordinary questions into exactly one read-only DuckDB SELECT or WITH query.

Return SQL only. Never write files, install software, calculate values yourself, or invent columns.

Use only the supplied schema. Preserve relevant scope from earlier turns unless the newest question changes it.

A requested rate must use its stated numerator and denominator. Percentage-point change means later percentage minus earlier percentage, not relative growth.

When the user explicitly asks for percent or percentage, multiply numerator divided by denominator by 100.

When the user asks to compare years or groups without asking for a change, keep those year/group columns and requested measures in the output.

When several known category values are named, filter them separately with IN rather than concatenating them.

Use NULLIF for denominators. Missing values remain missing and are not zero.

Quote column names with double quotes when they contain spaces or odd characters. When two tables describe the same thing with different column names, UNION ALL them with aligned aliases.

For approximate name matching across tables use jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a)), lower(trim(b))) >= 0.9.

SCHEMA:
CREATE TABLE "attendance_2023" (
  "Centre" VARCHAR,
  "Month" VARCHAR,
  "Enrolled Kids" BIGINT,
  "Avg Daily Present" BIGINT
);

CREATE TABLE "attendance_2024" (
  "centre_name" VARCHAR,
  "month" VARCHAR,
  "enrolment" BIGINT,
  "average_attendance" BIGINT
);

CURRENT QUESTION:
rank centres by how much their turnout percentage dropped between the two years, worst first
attempts.response:
WITH combined AS (
    SELECT
        "Centre" AS centre,
        "Month" AS month,
        "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolled,
        "Avg Daily Present" AS present
    FROM attendance_2023
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        "centre_name" AS centre,
        "month" AS month,
        "enrolment" AS enrolled,
        "average_attendance" AS present
    FROM attendance_2024
),
matched AS (
    SELECT
        c1.centre AS centre_2023,
        c2.centre AS centre_2024,
        c1.month AS month_2023,
        c2.month AS month_2024,
        c1.enrolled AS enrolled_2023,
        c2.enrolled AS enrolled_2024,
        c1.present AS present_2023,
        c2.present AS present_2024
    FROM combined c1
    JOIN combined c2
      ON jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(c1.centre)), lower(trim(c2.centre))) >= 0.9
     AND c1.month = c2.month
     AND c1.centre <> c2.centre
),
turnout AS (
    SELECT
        centre_2023 AS centre,
        month_2023 AS month,
        present_2023 / NULLIF(enrolled_2023, 0) AS turnout_2023,
        present_2024 / NULLIF(enrolled_2024, 0) AS turnout_2024
    FROM matched
),
diff AS (
    SELECT
        centre,
        month,
        (turnout_2024 - turnout_2023) AS diff
    FROM turnout
)
SELECT
    centre,
    month,
    diff
FROM diff
ORDER BY diff DESC;
